{
  "description": "X-TRACK is an embedded GPS bicycle speedometer firmware project using LVGL for GUI and TinyGPS++ for NMEA parsing. It runs on an AT32 MCU with offline map support, track recording (GPX export), and sensor integration (accelerometer, magnetometer). It does not implement a networked service architecture.",
  "version": "unknown",

    {
      "name": "Map Layer Management",
      "capability_id": "CAP.MAP.LAYERS",
      "coverage": "partial",
      "evidence_status": "verified",
      "confidence": 0.7,
      "evidence_refs": [
        "README.md@c42b8e56"
      ],
      "notes": "Supports offline map display and zooming on a single layer (the map). Does not support multiple overlay layers, vector tiles, or dynamic layer management as implied by the service requirement."
    },
    {
      "name": "Geofencing",
      "capability_id": "CAP.TRACK.GEOFENCE",
      "coverage": "none",

    },

      "coverage": "none",

  "interfaces_detail": [],

    "LVGL V8",

    "AT32 Standard Peripheral Library"
  ],

    "Embedded C (ARM Cortex-M4)",

  ],
  "deployment_constraints": [
    "Requires specific hardware: AT32F435CGU7 MCU",
    "Requires ST7789 IPS display",
    "Requires Micro SD card for map storage",
    "Requires GPS module (ATGM336H)"
  ],
  "maturity": "stable",
  "adaptation_hours_estimate": 120,
  "adaptation_confidence": "low",
  "adaptation_assumptions": [
    "The target component is a server-side service, while this repo is embedded firmware. Adaptation would require rewriting the core logic into a backend service.",
    "Offline map rendering logic would need to be ported to a server-side tile generation or vector rendering engine.",
    "GPX export functionality would need to be adapted to an API endpoint."
  ],
  "known_gaps": [
    "No network interfaces (REST/MQTT/WebSocket) implemented",
    "No geofencing capabilities",
    "No route computation algorithms",
    "No server-side position history storage or playback",
    "No stale position handling logic",
    "Single-layer map display only"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "Embedded firmware architecture is fundamentally different from a cloud service.",
    "Heavy dependency on specific hardware peripherals not present in a server environment.",
    "LVGL is a GUI library, not a backend mapping engine."
  ],
